from solution import replace_char


def test_issue_example_polygon():
    """Example: replace_char("polygon",'y','l')==("pollgon")."""
    result = replace_char("polygon", "y", "l")
    assert result == "pollgon"  # hand: p-o-l-y-g-o-n with y->l = p-o-l-l-g-o-n = "pollgon"


def test_issue_all_occurrences_replaced():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — every occurrence is replaced."""
    result = replace_char("banana", "a", "o")
    assert result == "bonono"  # hand: b-a-n-a-n-a with a->o at indexes 1,3,5 = b-o-n-o-n-o = "bonono"


def test_issue_no_match_leaves_string_unchanged():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — no match means unchanged."""
    result = replace_char("hello", "z", "x")
    assert result == "hello"  # hand: h-e-l-l-o contains no z, so stays h-e-l-l-o = "hello"


def test_issue_empty_string_stays_empty():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — empty input gives empty output."""
    result = replace_char("", "a", "b")
    assert result == ""  # hand: len 0 input with a->b has nothing to replace = ""


def test_issue_single_character_match():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — single-char boundary."""
    result = replace_char("y", "y", "l")
    assert result == "l"  # hand: single "y" with y->l = "l"


def test_issue_first_character_replaced():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — replacement at start boundary."""
    result = replace_char("apple", "a", "b")
    assert result == "bpple"  # hand: a-p-p-l-e with a->b at index 0 = b-p-p-l-e = "bpple"


def test_issue_last_character_replaced():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — replacement at end boundary."""
    result = replace_char("apple", "e", "y")
    assert result == "apply"  # hand: a-p-p-l-e with e->y at index 4 = a-p-p-l-y = "apply"


def test_issue_same_character_is_identity():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — replacing with itself changes nothing."""
    result = replace_char("hello", "l", "l")
    assert result == "hello"  # hand: h-e-l-l-o with l->l = h-e-l-l-o = "hello"


def test_issue_consecutive_occurrences_replaced():
    """Rule: replace characters in a string — adjacent matches are both replaced."""
    result = replace_char("balloon", "l", "t")
    assert result == "battoon"  # hand: b-a-l-l-o-o-n with l->t at indexes 2,3 = b-a-t-t-o-o-n = "battoon"


def test_contract_result_is_string():
    """Contract: example returns ("pollgon") so result must be a string."""
    result = replace_char("polygon", "y", "l")
    assert isinstance(result, str)  # hand: expected literal "pollgon" has type str


def test_contract_preserves_length():
    """Contract: replacing characters keeps the string length."""
    result = replace_char("polygon", "y", "l")
    assert len(result) == 7  # hand: len("polygon") = 7, so len(result) = 7


def test_contract_input_not_modified():
    """Contract: replace characters in a string without mutating the input."""
    s = "polygon"
    replace_char(s, "y", "l")
    assert s == "polygon"  # hand: original literal "polygon" must stay "polygon"
